notes.title: Rampage! Playtest
notes.notes:
We're good to go! I've let the first batch of participants in, you should now be seeing it in your library.

[b]Instructions for unlocking Rampage! mode[/b]
Look for the shotgun spawn in the main game mode--it'll spawn by the skeleton dude next to the campfire. Note: it’s not a guaranteed spawn and there’s only one per run, so it might take a few tries. Once found, Rampage! mode should be available in the main menu.

In Rampage! mode you spawn with a fully loaded shotgun, and the level generation logic has been altered to for a more action-oriented experience (fewer tunnels, more enemies, more ammo spawns, etc.). 

I'll mainly be gathering feedback in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/cosmocat]Cosmocat Discord[/url] (#toxicant channel), but I will check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3385940/discussions/0/592891262117395869/]this thread[/url] occasionally as well as post critical information here.
